description: Explicitly enable, disable or generate automatic subtitles for your film/episode, or choose which automatic translations are made (action translations with translation_mode: english = translate into English when the dialogue is not English, none = spoken-language subtitles only with saved translations kept, all = also switch finished translations in other languages back on). Only where the automatic-subtitle feature is enabled; does not enable it for the environment.

translation_mode.description: Required with action translations; list_film_subtitles shows the current one as translationMode.

name: set_automatic_subtitles
title: set automatic subtitles
